test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ramesh invested Rs. 1,232 at 5% p.a. rate of simple interest in a bank. What amount will he get after 3 years?
solution:
**Given**

Principal (P) = Rs. 1,232

Rate of Interest (R) = 5% p.a.

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

Amount (A) = Principal + Simple Interest

**Calculation**

SI = (1232 × 5 × 3) / 100

⇒ SI = 184.8

A = P + SI

⇒ A = 1232 + 184.8 = 1416.8

**∴ He will get Rs. 1416.8 after 3 years.**
